signal: secondary-limit `403` or `429` with no `retry-after` and `x-ratelimit-remaining` not `0`
decision: wait at least one minute before retrying (vendor policy: GitHub REST API, last-resort branch of the secondary-limit remedy)
quote: Otherwise, wait for at least one minute before retrying.

decision: cap pacing at 60 requests per hour (vendor policy: GitHub REST API, unauthenticated)
quote: The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.

signal: `x-ratelimit-limit` reads 5000 with a personal access token
decision: cap pacing at 5,000 requests per hour (vendor policy: GitHub REST API, personal token)
quote: All of these requests count towards your personal rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour.

decision: cap assumptions at the installation minimum of 5,000 requests per hour (vendor policy: GitHub App installations)
quote: GitHub Apps authenticating with an installation access token use the installation's minimum rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour.

decision: cap pacing at 1,000 requests per hour per repository (vendor policy: GitHub Actions `GITHUB_TOKEN`)
quote: The rate limit for GITHUB_TOKEN is 1,000 requests per hour per repository.

decision: cap the scaled installation budget at 12,500 requests per hour (vendor policy: GitHub REST API, non-Enterprise Cloud installations)
quote: The rate limit cannot increase beyond 12,500 requests per hour.

signal: parallel fan-out to one host (`concurrent requests`)
decision: cap concurrent requests at 100 (vendor policy: GitHub secondary limit, shared across REST and GraphQL)
quote: No more than 100 concurrent requests are allowed.

signal: weighted `points` burst on one REST endpoint
decision: cap weighted points at 900 per minute (vendor policy: GitHub secondary point limit, REST endpoints)
quote: No more than 900 points per minute are allowed for REST API endpoints

signal: summed `CPU time` proxy (total response time) over 60 s of wall clock
decision: cap estimated CPU time at 90 seconds per 60 seconds (vendor policy: GitHub secondary compute limit)
quote: No more than 90 seconds of CPU time per 60 seconds of real time is allowed.

decision: cap content-generating requests at 80 per minute (vendor policy, general case: some endpoints have lower limits)
quote: In general, no more than 80 content-generating requests per minute

decision: cap OAuth access token requests at 2,000 per hour (vendor policy: GitHub Apps and OAuth apps)
quote: No more than 2,000 OAuth access token requests per hour are allowed for GitHub Apps and OAuth apps.

decision: cap the LFS bucket at 300 requests per minute unauthenticated (vendor policy: separate LFS bucket)
quote: a limit of 300 requests per minute for unauthenticated requests and 3,000 requests per minute for authenticated requests
